match.title: Newcastle United vs Arsenal
match.h2h: Arsenal dominate the recent head-to-head series with 25 wins to Newcastle United's 7 alongside 3 draws, winning both Premier League meetings last season including a 1-0 home victory in April 2026 and a 2-1 triumph at St. James' Park in September 2025.
